changelog: feat: the rest of the BI report, plus presets and a single archive. THREE NEW TABS. QC Boxplot — a box per pipeline step over the samples, with every sample drawn on it, because a box alone hides how many samples are in it. Prevalence vs Abundance — how widespread each taxon is against how much of the community it is, log10 x axis, with the named labels nudged off each other and given leader lines: prevalence is a fraction of the sample count, so with four samples it takes four values and the names were printing straight over each other into one unreadable smear. Species Summary — samples detected and reads per species; the reads are DERIVED (per-sample percentage times that sample's non-chimeric depth, read from read_tracking.csv) and the column header says so, and if that file cannot be read the column is dropped with a note rather than an estimate printed as a count. GROUP ANNOTATION. A coloured strip per sample above the taxonomic heatmap and on both axes of the distance heatmap, PCoA/NMDS points coloured by group, UPGMA leaves coloured by group, one key, one colour per group across every chart. PCoA axes now carry the variance they explain, read from pca_scores.csv — without it an ordination is unreadable, because two points far apart on an axis worth 3% are not far apart. The key lists only groups that still have a sample on screen: it describes the picture, not metadata.csv. PER-GROUP SUMMARIES. Rarefaction curves as a group mean with a band from the group's lowest to its highest sample; alpha diversity as a box per group, one panel per metric, each panel on its own scale because Chao1 runs to 300 and Shannon to 4.5 and a shared axis would flatten Shannon into the baseline. PRESETS. A named look stored OUTSIDE any job (GET/POST /chart_presets, DELETE /chart_presets/{name}, one atomically-written file), so the styling worked out for one delivery can be put on the next instead of rebuilt by hand and not quite matching. Sizes, chart type, taxa shown, colour scale, group-mean and curve modes and TAXON colours travel; sample aliases, order, hidden samples and the groups themselves do not, because those name one job's samples and carrying them would silently rename or regroup data they do not belong to. ONE ARCHIVE, NOT 33 DOWNLOADS. Export all charts now writes a single ZIP. On a browser set to ask where to save, 33 charts meant 33 Save As dialogs. The ZIP is written here rather than pulled from a CDN, because this console is served off the user's own machine and may have no route out; stored rather than deflated, since a PNG is already compressed. If the archive cannot be built the charts still come out one at a time, and it says so. FIXES FOUND ON THE WAY. (1) rarefaction.csv writes NA past each sample's own depth, and NA was being read as TEXT — so the first sample column looked like a column of labels, the file was parsed as long format keyed by its own values, and the chart was built from nothing. NA, NaN, N/A, null and - are now missing numbers. (2) Opening the species summary switched the editor to the table view and left it there, so every tab opened afterwards came up as a table and the charts looked like they had stopped drawing; the previous view is restored on the way out. (3) Applying a preset repainted the panel, which rebuilt the <select> on its first option, so the next click on Delete had nothing selected and did nothing at all with no sign it had been ignored; the selection is now kept, and both buttons say so when nothing is picked. (4) The alpha box panels labelled only the first panel's x axis. Tests: 14 drivers, 479 checks, against the real U2Bio-139-v144Genus result folder.
